false_condition: In _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once the pass-wide snapshot (_persona_readback_snapshot) collapsed a FAILED batch owner read into an authoritative EMPTY result: list_all failure -> all_bindings={} and fleet-state failure -> monitoring_sessions=[]. _evaluate_persona_provisioning_status treated {} as 'owner lists no RuntimeBinding for this plan' (binding_ok=False, binding_failed=False) and [] as 'no worker joined' (heartbeat_failed=False, heartbeat_ok=False). Neither sets a failure flag, so the Persona stayed provisioning until is_timeout produced provisioning_timeout as the ONLY failure reason. The operator route passes no batch (None), so it reads list_by_plan and the session store per Persona and sees the same owner state as true.
why_route_differs: The route calls _evaluate_persona_provisioning_status without all_bindings/all_monitoring_sessions, so it always performs the direct per-Persona owner reads; the background pass trusted the once-per-pass batch even when it was empty because the batch read had failed or was stale.
